title: Profiles: Should not start with .
description:
A profile name should not start with a dot. As a side-effect this
will also take care of situations, where users have stored their
profiles in a repository, which created a .directory in the
profile directory.

Fixes #18736

notes.body: @stigbjorlykke the change will introduce a new behaviour for all plattforms, as it will also prevent . for Linux and macOS. In the sense of consistency as well as cross-portability of zip-exports, I think that makes sense. But I will not merge without your approval

I'm not sure what will be the best here.

I don't like restrictions on one platform because another platform has issues. But as you say we do support export and import profiles between platforms. To fully support this we need to restrict `\/:*?"<>|` on all platforms.

If a user has an existing profile starting with dot then this will suddenly not work, which is not good. And if adding more restrictions on all platform then more existing profiles will not work.

Maybe we should add a warning to the export/import instead?
What does the import do on Windows if getting a invalid profile name?

ProfileModel::cleanName will check for validity. On Windows it will prevent importing a directory that starts or ends with a . . On Linux that would be valid.

Same here. I am also not that keen on suddenly preventing stuff that worked. But I see the ".git" use-case, in which a user has saved his profiles in a repo, and that name would always show up, except if we check if a directory contains valid files (which we do not at the moment). That check could also take quite some time if you have many profiles
